article.title: Open Me Series Books: 20 Titles from 3000 Studios Press (2026 Guide)
article.author: Jeremy Swain
article.summary: Every open me series title from 3000 Studios Press in one place: 20 original books by Jeremy Swain, $9.99 each as EPUB and PDF.
article.leadParagraph: Looking for open me series books? 3000 Studios Press publishes 20 original open me series titles written by Jeremy Swain. Interactive gift books for every room of the house. This guide lists every one, explains what each shelf offers, and shows exactly where to buy them.

sections.heading: The full Open Me Series shelf
body: The shelf includes “Open Me: Home for the Holidays”, “Open Me: Closets and Skeletons”, “Open Me: The Porch”, “Open Me: The Mailbox”, “Open Me: Open House” and “Open Me: Upstairs Downstairs”.
It also includes “Open Me: The Fridge Door”, “Open Me: Keys Under the Mat”, “Open Me: The Nightstand Book”, “Open Me: Basement Tapes”, “Open Me: The Garage Sale” and “Open Me: Company's Coming”.
It also includes “Open Me: A Room for That”, “Open Me: The Junk Drawer”, “Open Me If You Dare”, “Open Me at Christmas”, “Open Me: The Money Edition” and “Open Me After Midnight”.
It also includes “Open Me Again: Even More Everything” and “Open Me: The Book of Everything”.

sections.heading: Price and formats
body: Every title on the shelf is $9.99. Each purchase includes both EPUB and PDF, delivered at checkout from the studio store on Payhip, so the same book works on an e-reader, a tablet, a phone or a printer.
Print editions of the wider 3000 Studios Press catalog are distributed through IngramSpark, which means bookstores and libraries can order copies through their usual channels.

sections.heading: Where to buy
body: Open the Books page at https://3000studios.vip/books and tap any cover to go straight to that title's checkout. The Open Me Series filter on that page shows only this shelf.
New releases and chapter previews land first in the free 3000 Studios Substack newsletter.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
body: How many open me series books does 3000 Studios Press publish? 20, all listed above.
Who writes them? Every title is written by Jeremy Swain and published under the 3000 Studios Press imprint.
What do I get? A $9.99 purchase includes the EPUB and the PDF of the book.
